name: github-settings-as-code
description: GitHub Action applying declarative repository settings: rulesets, labels, branch protection, and more.

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run lint:yaml && bun run typecheck && bun run knip && bun run test && bun run build:check
scripts.lint:yaml: if command -v yamllint >/dev/null 2>&1; then git ls-files -z '*.yml' '*.yaml' | xargs -0 yamllint -s; else echo 'lint:yaml: yamllint not installed, skipping (CI enforces it; install with pip install yamllint or brew install yamllint)'; fi
scripts.build: bun run build:bundle && bun run build:schema
scripts.build:check: bun run build:schema && git diff --exit-code lib/settings.schema.json && ! git ls-files --others --exclude-standard lib/settings.schema.json | grep .
